family.description: This family contains members from all branches of life. The molecular function of this protein is unknown, but Memo (mediator of ErbB2-driven cell motility) a human protein is included in this family [[cite:PUB00044702]]. It has been suggested that Memo controls cell migration by relaying extracellular chemotactic signals to the microtubule cytoskeleton [[cite:PUB00044702]].
family.name: Memo-like protein
